description: Read-only Cerbo power and BMS stability observatory. Batteries remain independent; transport state and field validity are qualified separately.

panels.title: Scope, safety and current data state

options.content:
## Cerbo Power Observatory
Separate monitoring for **battery1 / inverter1** and **battery2 / inverter2**. Battery1 is owner-reported JK-BMS over Bluetooth on Cerbo; battery2 is owner-reported JK-BMS over CAN. Home Assistant is a later additional source.

**No matching Cerbo/JK/power-monitor series were present in Minizon Prometheus at publication time (2026-09-14).** Blank panels mean no telemetry. Unknown, invalid and stale values must never be exported as zero. This dashboard does not change Cerbo, BMS, DVCC, charging or inverter settings.

The normalized `power_monitor_*` metric contract is prepared for a reviewed collector. Existing `anern_*` AC-input V/Hz are also queried. Grid W appears only from a real, explicitly mapped Grid measurement; output power is never relabelled as Grid power.

panels.title: Collector reachable
panels.description: Successful scrape of the normalized power collector. Scrape success is not device health.

panels.title: Battery 1 sample fresh
panels.description: Exporter-qualified freshness for explicitly mapped battery1. Unsupported freshness remains no telemetry.

panels.title: Battery 2 sample fresh
panels.description: Exporter-qualified freshness for explicitly mapped battery2. This does not establish CAN health.

panels.title: Battery 1 Bluetooth link
panels.description: BlueZ link state for a device explicitly mapped to battery1. Link state does not prove fresh BMS payloads.

panels.title: Battery 2 D-Bus connected
panels.description: The battery2 service-reported connection flag. It is separate from CAN controller state and per-field validity.

panels.title: CAN RX errors / 15m
panels.description: Increase of interface-wide CAN RX errors. It is not automatically attributable to battery2.

panels.title: State of charge
panels.description: Per-device SOC only. No averaged or combined bank SOC.

panels.title: Field validity
panels.description: A missing SOC with present voltage/current is partial telemetry evidence; it does not prove a CAN-layer fault.

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: Per-service voltage. System overview fallback voltage is excluded unless exported as a separate source.

panels.title: Battery current
panels.description: Source-reported sign convention; verify charge/discharge polarity for each integration.

panels.title: Battery power
panels.description: Reported power only. The dashboard does not multiply asynchronous voltage and current or total the banks.

panels.title: Battery temperature
panels.description: Per-device reported temperatures. Missing sensors remain absent.

panels.title: Cell voltage extrema
panels.description: BMS-reported minimum and maximum cell voltage. Cell identity is shown only if the source supplies it.

panels.title: BMS permissions and alarms
panels.description: Observed read-only BMS permission/alarm values. This dashboard does not change charge or discharge permissions.

panels.title: Bluetooth connection and services
panels.description: BlueZ Connected and ServicesResolved are link/service-discovery states, not BMS payload freshness. Requires explicit device-to-bank mapping.

panels.title: Bluetooth RSSI
panels.description: Optional advertising/inquiry RSSI. An absent value is unknown; it is not a disconnection event.

panels.title: CAN controller error counters
panels.description: Interface-wide kernel counters. ERROR-ACTIVE is normal controller state; changes require correlation with service and field validity.

panels.title: D-Bus service ownership changes
panels.description: Owner changes may indicate service restart. Failed owner verification must not increment this counter.

panels.title: Inverter output and internal PV
panels.description: Inverter output and internal PV are distinct. Neither is Grid import power.

panels.title: Anern AC input voltage
panels.description: Existing Anern exporter metric. AC input voltage does not prove relay state or imported power. Device-local L1 is not household L1.

panels.title: Anern AC input frequency
panels.description: Existing Anern exporter metric. Gaps mean no fresh observation.

panels.title: Real Grid power, when available
panels.description: Only a real, explicitly mapped Grid source may publish this series. No inverter output or battery/PV estimate is substituted.

options.content:
**SOC missing while V/A remain:** first compare the per-battery service with the GX system-selected battery and voltage services. The overview may retain V/A from another source. Treat the symptom as partial telemetry until service ownership, source selection and CAN evidence correlate.

**Bluetooth:** separate link loss, incomplete service discovery and connected-but-invalid telemetry. Do not assume a JK-BMS accepts two simultaneous active clients when Home Assistant is added.

**Timing:** scrape time is observer time, not a synchronized hardware timestamp. Sampling can miss short faults. Do not calculate energy or cross-bank balance from these panels.
